_note: Delhi's real revenue-district structure — district names match what OpenStreetMap/Nominatim actually returns for a Delhi coordinate's `address.state_district` (verified live), so any geocoded point in Delhi maps onto one of these without guessing ward boundaries. District Magistrate and DCP office titles are real, stable structure (every Delhi revenue district has both). MCD zone alignment per district is an approximate best-effort pairing — MCD zones are the Municipal Corporation's own administrative division and don't align 1:1 with revenue-district boundaries — treat it as indicative, not authoritative. Office names are real; officer names are fictional placeholders, same convention as directory.json/jurisdictions.json. Never used to contact anyone real.

top.cm_office: Chief Minister's Office, Government of NCT of Delhi
top.ddma: Delhi Disaster Management Authority (DDMA) — chaired by the Chief Minister
top.lg_office: Office of the Lieutenant Governor of Delhi (Raj Niwas) — constitutional authority over Delhi Police, public order and land under the GNCTD Act
top.police_commissioner: Office of the Commissioner of Police, Delhi

North East Delhi.dm_office: District Magistrate (Deputy Commissioner), North East District
North East Delhi.dcp_office: DCP, North East District, Delhi Police

New Delhi.dm_office: District Magistrate (Deputy Commissioner), New Delhi District
New Delhi.dcp_office: DCP, New Delhi District, Delhi Police
New Delhi.mcd_zone: New Delhi Municipal Council (NDMC) — administered separately from MCD

North West Delhi.dcp_office: DCP, North West District, Delhi Police
